Class LobbyModel

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am02.client.model.LobbyModel
public class LobbyModel extends Object
Holds the client-side state of the pre-game lobby phase.

Receives lobby-related notifications from ClientNetworkDispatcher and pushes granular updates to all registered ClientView observers.

All public methods are synchronized on the model's own monitor.

    • updateUsernameResult

      public void updateUsernameResult(String username, boolean isValid, String reason)
      Applies the result of a username request: stores the accepted nickname and notifies all views.
      Parameters:
      username - the requested username
      isValid - true if the server accepted the nickname
      reason - the rejection reason, or null if accepted

    • updateAvailableLobbies

      public void updateAvailableLobbies(List<LobbyInfo> lobbies)
      Applies a full lobby list update received from the server. Also resets the local current-lobby and nickname references to reflect that this client is now in the pre-lobby state.
      Parameters:
      lobbies - the current list of available open lobbies

    • updateCurrentLobby

      public void updateCurrentLobby(LobbyInfo lobby)
      Applies an incremental update to the lobby this client is currently in.
      Parameters:
      lobby - the updated lobby state

      Applies a lobby dissolution event: clears the current lobby reference and notifies all views.

    • updateError

      public void updateError(String errorMessage)
      Applies an error notification from the server: forwards the message to all registered views.
      Parameters:

    • getMyNickname

      public String getMyNickname()

      public List<LobbyInfo> getAvailableLobbies()
